$description: ATR Lab (Advanced Telerobotics Research Lab, Kent State University) color tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. Generated by src/build_tokens.py; do not edit by hand.

brand.$description: Brand primaries = Kent State's primary palette (kent.edu/brand/swatches). Use at 100% opacity.

navy.$description: Kent State Blue / ATR Navy. Primary. Titles, headers, navy fields, primary chart series, the lab mark on light backgrounds.

gold.$description: Kent State Gold / ATR Gold. Primary. Fills, large marks, the mark on navy, section fields, hazard stripes. Never text or thin rules on white (2.0:1).

edu.kent.atr.note: rgb is the ATR digital value (= the hex). rgbKsuListed is what Kent State prints beside the hex: 235 171 32, which does not match #EFAB00. ATR standardizes on #EFAB00 (239 171 0) for digital, matching the lab logo artwork.

ksu.$description: Kent State secondary ('refined') palette. Supporting roles only, used sparingly.

midnight.$description: Midnight (KSU refined). Deep navy for large dark fields and gradients' dark end.

sky.$description: Sky (KSU refined). Support accent, focus rings, third chart series. Large text only on white (3.6:1).

flash.$description: Flash (KSU refined). Rare highlight on navy. Never on white.

steel.$description: Steel (KSU refined). Decorative only (2.7:1 on white). Not for text or meaningful lines.

silver.$description: Silver (KSU refined). Decorative only (2.0:1 on white).

functional.$description: ATR functional neutrals (lab additions) for text and UI.

ink.$description: Ink. Body text on light backgrounds (15.5:1 on white).

edu.kent.atr.cmykNote: Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.

slate.$description: Slate. Secondary text, captions, axis labels (7.3:1 on white).

edu.kent.atr.cmykNote: Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.

bronze.$description: Bronze. Gold-family text and thin gold-family rules on white/light (5.5:1).

edu.kent.atr.cmykNote: Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.

mist.$description: Mist. Light panel / alternate background (cool, never cream).

edu.kent.atr.cmykNote: Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.
Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.

white.$description: White. Page background, text on navy.

edu.kent.atr.cmykNote: Computed sRGB -> Generic CMYK (relative colorimetric). Not a published spec; proof before print.

ramp.$description: Tint/shade ramps generated in OKLCH (see README). Brand/functional colors are pinned at the step that matches their lightness and are aliases, so the ramp can never drift from the brand.

semantic.$description: Role-based tokens. Use these in products instead of raw colors. 'light' is the default mode.

primary.$description: Body text, headings on light backgrounds.

muted.$description: Tertiary text, placeholders, footnotes. AA on white (5.1) and mist (4.7) only: NOT on bg.subtle (4.3), use text.secondary there.

accent.$description: Gold-family text on light backgrounds (eyebrows, small caps labels).

on-navy.$description: Text on navy and midnight fields.

on-gold.$description: Text on gold fields (navy on gold, 5.7:1).

on-gold-strong.$description: Highest-contrast text on gold (7.7:1), for long copy on gold.

subtle.$description: Hover rows, code blocks, inset wells.

inverse.$description: Navy fields: title slides, headers, footers.

accent.$description: Gold fields: section dividers, callout bands, stickers.

accent-subtle.$description: Highlight wash (search hits, 'new' rows). Never a page background.

strong.$description: Meaningful UI boundaries: inputs, checkboxes (3.6:1, passes 3:1 non-text).

accent.$description: Thin gold-family rules on white (gold itself fails as a thin rule).

link.$description: Links on light backgrounds. Always underlined (only 2.7:1 against ink body text).

ring.$description: Focus outline: 3.6:1 on white, 3.3:1 on mist, 3.2:1 on navy. Use 2px+ with 2px offset.

ring-on-gold.$description: Focus outline on gold fields (sky fails on gold).

muted.$description: Tertiary text on dark surfaces. AA on the dark page (7.4) and panel (6.3) only: NOT on bg.subtle (4.4), use text.secondary there.

on-gold.$description: Unchanged: gold fields keep navy text in both modes.

accent.$description: Gold rules on dark surfaces are fine (9.2:1).

ring.$description: Sky works on dark too (5.1:1 on the dark page).

status.$description: UI feedback states. Always paired with an icon and a text label, never color alone. Reserved: never reuse for data series.

fg.$description: success text/icon on white, mist or its bg tint

bg-dark.$description: success background tint on dark surfaces

fg.$description: warning text/icon on white, mist or its bg tint

bg-dark.$description: warning background tint on dark surfaces

fg.$description: danger text/icon on white, mist or its bg tint

bg-dark.$description: danger background tint on dark surfaces

fg.$description: info text/icon on white, mist or its bg tint

bg-dark.$description: info background tint on dark surfaces

milestone.$description: Quad-chart / schedule milestone states. Encode with shape + label + color. Fill is the marker fill; stroke is its outline (gives at-risk and not-started a >=3:1 edge on white).

edu.kent.atr.label: At risk
edu.kent.atr.shape: filled diamond with ! (◆), dark amber outline

dataviz.$description: Chart colors. Assign categorical slots in order, never cycle; >8 series fold into 'Other' or facet.

categorical.$description: Fixed order. Light = white chart surface; dark = the dark page (#0D1521). Slots 1-2 are the exact brand primaries (brand-anchor exception to the lightness band). Stacked/grouped bars: all 8 slots (adjacent pairs validate). Lines, scatter, bubble, maps, small multiples: max 4 colored series (slots 1-4 validate all-pairs); 5-8 lines only with direct end labels plus marker/dash redundancy. Plot area always on chrome.<mode>.surface (not panel/subtle/mist).

sequential.$description: One hue, light->dark = low->high on light surfaces (50 -> 900); flipped on dark (900 -> 50, dark = low). 10 stops in both modes. Continuous (heatmaps). Interpolate in OKLab between stops.

ordinal.$description: Discrete ordered classes (tiers, stages, TRL). Light end clears 2:1 on the surface.

diverging.$description: navy <-> bronze, 11 stops, lightness-symmetric arms, neutral gray midpoint (stop 6). Stop 1 = strongest negative (navy), stop 11 = strongest positive (bronze).
